title: The Ridge Where Parallel Roads Converge

features.name: first-homestead
features.desc-on-touch: A small weathered house where one path ended, where someone lived believing their choice was singular and final.

features.name: second-homestead
features.desc-on-touch: Another weathered house, in the same spot, where someone else lived a parallel life. The earth holds both places at once.

features.name: the-roads-themselves
features.desc-on-touch: Two paths, certain they were parallel, rising through paddocks until their lines meet on this ridge. The convergence point holds both histories at equal weight.

features.name: the-convergence-gate
features.desc-on-touch: Where the parallel roads finally touch. An archway of stone and weathered wood, marking the point where two separate lives became one geography.

features.name: the-choice-post
features.desc-on-touch: A fence post on the ridge, deeply carved with two sets of initials pointing in opposite directions. Yet you stand on the ridge reading them both at once.

inscription: both paths home; you chose once but the earth keeps the score of twice

reverie.title: REVERIE — the ridge where both of you arrived from different
narr: You walk the ridge-line while Katita traces the road-edges on her map.
"It's the same place twice," she says. "They converge here but they don't
know it yet. Look." She points at the coordinates that hold both houses.
The sun is catching the convergence-gate, throwing one shadow, two
directions at once. "The earth remembers both choices," she whispers.
And you both understand: the archive was built to hold this—not one answer
